Four exact rational distinct directions yield equal full chord laws for a rectangle and nonrectangular parallelogram. The standalone checker verified exact obstruction and sample inversions and 21 independently integrated clipping moments; the all-direction proof is analytic.

value.rationale: Answers a natural sharp sensor-count problem: five arbitrarily oriented predetermined measurement directions give exact identification of a full continuous family of Euclidean parallelograms from only two moments per view, whereas four can fail even with infinite information per sampled law. The sharp lower bound and explicit reconstruction reduce the gap between forward chord formulae and finite geometric tomography.
